title: Select Revelations of S. Mechtild
author: Mechthild of Magdeburg
description: Selected revelations associated with Mechthild of Magdeburg's visionary spirituality. The text offers access to a medieval devotional world shaped by divine love, the soul's longing and the language of mystical encounter.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/selectrevelation00mech).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
